title: Northstar Launch Readiness
summary: Current owners, decision gates, and rollback criteria for the Northstar launch.
content: The launch is in controlled rollout. Product owns the go/no-go decision, Support owns the escalation brief, and Engineering owns rollback execution.

title: Support Escalation Path
summary: The current severity definitions and escalation owners for customer-impacting incidents.
content: Severity 1 incidents page the incident commander and customer lead immediately. Severity 2 incidents enter the hourly triage queue.

claims.text: Severity 1 incidents page the incident commander and customer lead.

title: Legacy Vendor Review
summary: An expired assessment retained for historical comparison.
content: The prior review approved the vendor for a limited pilot. Its approval window has expired and must not be treated as current authorization.

claims.text: The vendor was approved for a limited pilot.
